name: Dragon Spring Farm
description: Dragon Spring Farm is a small farm in 6115 Santa Rosa Creek Road, CA. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
